title.narrative: Welthungerhilfe Anticipatory Humanitarian Action Facility (WAHAFA) South Sudan Build Project

description.narrative: Overall Objective: The proposed WAHAFA project is aimed at proactively assisting vulnerable communities in South Sudan exposed to disaster risks before the peak of the hazards and risks.

The project focus is targeting the most at risk vulnerable communities, as follows;Panyijiar: Total population =120,261, Expected vulnerable population =96,000Aweil North: Total population =168, 813,Expected vulnerable population =119,000Note: Time of occurrence of hazards (floods) in Panyijiar is projected from September to December, whereas drought in Aweil North is projected from March to June, and August to November; whereas, Floods projections are from September to December.

The proposed WAHAFA project is aimed at proactively assisting vulnerable communities in South Sudan exposed to disaster risks before the peak of the hazards and risks. Welthungerhilfe South Sudan, in partnership with local actors are looking forward to pilot the development and support of community based early action protocols for floods and drought in Panyijiar county (Unity State) and Aweil West county (Northern Bar- el Ghazal state). Welthungerhilfe will work with local partners (Hope Restoration South Sudan and Hope Agency for Relief and Development) in Panyijiar and Aweil North counties respectively. This pilot will see the operationalization of a forecast- based mechanism to assist the communities at risk in advance before the peak of the hazards based on a scientific trigger.
